answer: In this PoA design, each agent identity is bound to a remotely attested enclave measurement, MRENCLAVE, and its signed report is verified before participation. Reproducing an identity therefore requires approved enclave code and fresh hardware-backed attestation: cloning identities demands purchasing physical silicon, while copying keys or launching virtual machines cannot duplicate the measurement. A horizon of trust spans tundra deployments, with each vertex remaining silicon-rooted.
